title: Gaming and IRL worlds collide in Jumanji: Open World trailer
summary: Kasdan gave the franchise a welcome major overhaul with the release of 2017’s Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle , updating the original board game into a vintage video game and giving us a hugely entertaining action-adventure.
